User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user account in the thecueRoom application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user account.

artistName.description: The user's artist or project name.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

verified.description: Indicates whether the user's account has been verified.

submittedLink.description: The URL submitted by the user for profile verification.

verificationStatus.description: The current status of the user's verification process (e.g., queued, passed).

definition.description: Stores user profile information. Includes denormalized fields for verification status to support authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user. This is the document ID and matches the Firebase Authentication UID.
